name: es30-shadow-mapping
title: Shadow Mapping
summary: A lit 3D scene with directional-light shadows: a depth-only FBO pass into a DEPTH_COMPONENT24 texture, then a sampler2DShadow lookup (COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE) with hardware and 3x3 PCF, polygon-offset bias, a shadow-map inset through a sampler object, validated against an analytic CPU ray-cast model of the scene.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.8.2 Sampler Objects (a bound sampler supersedes the texture's sampling state)
ES 3.0 §3.8.3 Texture Image Specification (depth formats), §3.8.4 Immutable-Format Texture Images
ES 3.0 §3.8.13 Texture Completeness (depth texture with comparison NONE needs NEAREST filters)
ES 3.0 §3.8.15 Texture Comparison Modes, §3.8.15.1 Depth Texture Comparison Mode (table 3.23; filtered results are implementation-dependent)
ES 3.0 §4.2.1 Selecting Buffers for Writing (DrawBuffers), §4.3.1 Selecting Buffers for Reading (ReadBuffer)
ES 3.0 §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (no depth read-back; INVALID_OPERATION when READ_BUFFER is NONE)
ES 3.0 §4.4.2 Attaching Images to Framebuffer Objects, §4.4.3 Feedback Loops, §4.4.4 Framebuffer Completeness
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers (sampler2DShadow has none, sampler2D is lowp)
GLSL ES 3.00 §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_VertexID), §7.2 Fragment Shader Special Variables (gl_FragCoord)
GLSL ES 3.00 §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions (shadow forms, texelFetch)

api.glGenTextures: shadow map (DEPTH_COMPONENT24) and RGBA8 read-back target exist and are used by the validated passes
api.glBindTexture: the same depth texture bound to units 0 and 1; per-unit lookups differ (compare vs raw) as observed
api.glActiveTexture: units 0 (comparing) and 1 (raw depth through a sampler) address the same texture; SAMPLER_BINDING per unit read back
api.glTexStorage2D: DEPTH_COMPONENT24 1024x1024 immutable storage: FRAMEBUFFER_ATTACHMENT_DEPTH_SIZE >= 24, depth values read back; RGBA8 1x16 read-back target
api.glTexParameteri: MIN/MAG filter NEAREST vs LINEAR switches hard vs filtered comparison (penumbra counts); COMPARE_MODE/COMPARE_FUNC read back and ALWAYS/NEVER/GREATER/LEQUAL change the image exactly as table 3.23 predicts (via the typed glTexParameter overloads)
api.glGetTexParameteriv: TEXTURE_COMPARE_MODE == COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE, TEXTURE_COMPARE_FUNC == LEQUAL, and the LEQUAL restore
api.glGenFramebuffers: depth-only shadow framebuffer and RGBA8 dump framebuffer are used by validated passes
api.glBindFramebuffer: pass 1 renders into the shadow FBO, the default framebuffer shows pass 2; both observed
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: DEPTH_ATTACHMENT texture: depth values equal analytic depths; COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 texture: dump pass output read back; attachment object type/name queried
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: COMPLETE with a single depth attachment and no color attachment (both FBOs)
api.glGetFramebufferAttachmentParameteriv: DEPTH_ATTACHMENT OBJECT_TYPE == TEXTURE, OBJECT_NAME == shadow texture, DEPTH_SIZE >= 24; COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 OBJECT_TYPE == NONE
api.glDrawBuffers: NONE on the shadow FBO read back as DRAW_BUFFER0; COLOR_ATTACHMENT1 at index 0 raises INVALID_OPERATION and leaves the state unchanged (4.2.1)
api.glReadBuffer: NONE on the shadow FBO read back as READ_BUFFER; glReadPixels from it raises INVALID_OPERATION; BACK with an FBO bound raises INVALID_OPERATION (4.3.1)
api.glGenSamplers: raw-depth sampler object supersedes the texture's COMPARE_REF_TO_TEXTURE on unit 1: depth values through it match the CPU model (inset and dump pass)
api.glSamplerParameteri: COMPARE_MODE NONE + NEAREST filters make the plain sampler2D / texelFetch reads defined and exact; read back with glGetSamplerParameteriv
api.glBindSampler: unit 1 reads raw depth while unit 0 (no sampler) compares; SAMPLER_BINDING per unit read back
api.glPolygonOffset: measured depth offset = factor * m (+ units * r) within the §3.6.2 range on ground texels; POLYGON_OFFSET_FACTOR/UNITS read back; removes shadow acne in all three PCF modes (bias-off image acnes on 53 % of lit ground pixels, predicted exactly by the CPU)
api.glEnable: POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL (stored depth shifts only with it enabled) and DEPTH_TEST (pass 1 keeps the nearest surface, texels covered by shapes are nearer than the ground)
api.glDisable: POLYGON_OFFSET_FILL disabled again (glIsEnabled), depth/cull state of the inset and dump passes
api.glDepthFunc: LESS in pass 1: the stored depth is the nearest surface (depth read-back vs analytic nearest hit)
api.glClearDepthf: 1.0 before each pass; stale depth would hide the polygon-offset shift in the repeated read-back
api.glClearColor: sky pixels equal the clear colour (580 pixels, +-1 level)
api.glClear: COLOR|DEPTH of the camera pass (sky pixels, depth-tested image) and DEPTH of pass 1 (repeated read-back stays exact)
api.glViewport: shadow-map viewport 1024x1024, inset sub-rectangle, 16x1 dump row; probed pixels land where the CPU model predicts
api.glGenBuffers: vertex and index buffers of the cube, sphere and ground meshes feed the validated draws
api.glBindBuffer: ARRAY_BUFFER and ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER (VAO state) of every mesh
api.glBufferData: mesh data observed through rendered pixels and depths
api.glGenVertexArrays: one VAO per mesh plus an empty VAO for attribute-less draws
api.glBindVertexArray: mesh selection per draw; empty VAO for gl_VertexID triangles
api.glEnableVertexAttribArray: position and normal attributes sourced from the mesh buffer
api.glVertexAttribPointer: interleaved position/normal; normals observed through the lighting equation
api.glDrawElements: indexed triangles of all meshes in both passes; geometry matches the analytic CPU model
api.glDrawArrays: attribute-less oversized triangle (gl_VertexID): inset pixels and the dump row are exact
api.glGetUniformLocation: all uniforms of the four programs located (setup would fail visibly otherwise)
api.glUniform1i: sampler unit of u_shadow / u_depth, u_pcf_radius selecting 1 or 9 taps (penumbra experiment)
api.glUniform1f: bias, texel size, fog, material scalars observed through pixel values and acne
api.glUniform2f: inset depth range and view window observed through the inset pixels
api.glUniform3f: light direction, eye, colours and albedo observed through the lighting equation
api.glUniform2iv: array of 16 texel coordinates indexed in the fragment shader; read-back depths belong to the requested texels
api.glUniformMatrix3fv: normal matrix of every object observed through diffuse/specular shading
api.glUniformMatrix4fv: model, view-projection and light view-projection matrices observed through geometry, shadow position and depth
api.glUseProgram: four programs (depth pass, scene, inset, depth dump) each produce validated output
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the default framebuffer and of the dump row; INVALID_OPERATION from the color-less FBO

visual_review.notes: 256x256 captures of gpu (radeonsi), llvmpipe and zink, es-max and es-min: horizon haze over a warm checker ground with sky above; a stone platform carrying a red sphere, a teal cube and a floating blue sphere; four pillars with a lintel behind; an orange box with a spinning purple box on the left. Shadows are crisp and consistent: the red sphere's ellipse on the platform and ground, the blue sphere's detached shadow, striped pillar shadows to the right, the purple box shadowing the orange box's top; faces turned away from the light show ambient colour only; no acne speckle. The yellow-framed inset (top-left) shows the shadow map as gray iso-depth bands with the scene's shapes as distortions. Interactive run under xvfb (P, B, Space, A, W keys driven with xdotool) showed acne stripes with bias off and PCF off, and a fine hatching with PCF on.
